content.label: What an active developer, always making thoughtful and nuanced improvements! ❤️
A great reminder/timer app. Much better than the default apps. And very reasonably priced!  Wonderful value.

title.label: Love this. Keeps me looking like a superstar

content.label: I write down everything to do and then organize as to when I will do it. Everyday I can reorganize and prioritize. Mainly I love the persistent reminders to make me aware of something until I do it. I used to have to write urgent things on my hand!

title.label: DUE is best reminder system available

content.label: I have used DUE on my iPhone for two years now and it is irreplaceable for me. It is the most useful system as you can customize your reminders to fit any situation, snooze as many times as you want, change reminders on the fly and set timers if needed. Keep up the great work!

I’ve been using Due for two years and initially my only qualm is that there is no “end date” for reminders, like on the iOS Calendar App. Then, I realized that “logged” reminders in many cases aren’t there when searched! There are pop ups but the detail is gone. Reached out to support and they we’re clueless. I still use but no longer trust for past reminders.
Tried many reminder Aps and Due is unquestionably the best
Great tool to nag me until I get stuff done. Works well on Apple Watch so I am reminded while away from my keyboard.
THE best and most reliable reminder/task app I've ever used; hands down. BPL CPA

The only reminders app i can trust to handle  super important tasks.
They also are great at providing regular all maintenance; adding new clever features and updating bugs more than any other reminders app that I've used and embarrassingly I've tried them all 🫣. 

For me, Due is best used for my priority reminders and i use other apps for undated,  'later' or 'someday', 'projects' and other low urgency tasks.

It also works with Siri and has uncomplicated export options, which not all task apps are good at.

Highly recommend watching the less than five minute tutorial in the Help section , as I have been using the app for years, and still didn't realize some of the shortcuts the tutorial highlights.

The only two features I wish they have, is an editable notes entru field for individual reminders(like the Apple Reminders app has) and more help section screencasts. 

I thank 🙏the Due App team for creating an app I depend on to complete urgent time sensitive tasks thereby preventing me from f*ing up my life 🤪. 
P.S. the protaganist in the film 'Momento' should have definetly tried Due. 😂

Due has been life changing for me. I use it every day to remind myself about everything from big to small. I no longer forget about tasks like mailing a package or taking medicine. It is really easy to set up a recurring reminder, and the customizable time slots lets me push a task to the next day or the weekend if I can’t get to it.

how does anyone live without this app? i use it for so many things. to remind me of daily tasks i tend to forget (e.g. take vitamins with dinner). i use it for weekly or monthly’s tasks (e.g. log a report weekly). i remind myself a few hours before a dr appointment. i love that it keeps reminding me until make a decision. sometimes don’t have time to log the report on Monday, so i’ll move the reminder to Tuesday. or i’ll delete a reminder i no longer need. or just push it later. love this app.

This app has some potential, but does not do as advertised. Was not able to make work with Siri and was not able to import reminders. And of course try to get refund but only got practice. I recommend using an app called Reminder. It is free, imports, Apple reminders, and calendar events. unfortunately, it doesn’t have any auto syncing capability with Calendar and Reminders.
Anytime you initiate a shortcut from the share sheet it freezes my shortcuts app and phone has to be rebooted. Do not download this app. It needs major fixing

title.label: My life would not be the same without this app

content.label: Title

Such a helpful support structure. 
I’m constantly tweaking the reminders I need but Due copes and is always there to rely on.

I was using other apps like Apple Reminder and Pill reminder but they were not reliable or the notification was not heard and I missed things like a Dr appointment. With Due it is impossible to miss something and it keeps reminding you until you check off the reminder, it is easy to see what is coming up in the following week and month.  One problem that I have had is when my Iphone is in sleep I only get a notification on my Apple Watch. I was able to fix that by disabling wrist detection on my Apple Watch. Now I get notifications all the time on my IPhone even when it is in sleep.
Also I like the timer feature in Due.
This app is totally worth $7.99

title.label: Not as Easy as it says

content.label: Okay, I just purchased this app and am regretting it.  Maybe I'm missing something, but I need a Reminder to clock in, out, etc, but only work Monday through Thursday.  I can find no way to select just those days as in the reminder app on my iPhone.  And I really don't care when I set the reminder up.  Not impressed so far.

It is hard to write this as it is hard to admit that I have dementia, but that’s what I am living with following 3 strokes.
Due is a lifesaver.  My medicine reminders are set to keep reminding me every 15 minutes until I mark it done.  No way to forget to do it now as long as I don’t mark it done before I actually complete the task.  It is very simple to use.  Definitely worth the few dollars.

It would be absolutely perfect if there was a way to ORGANIZE tasks by lists!! I’d love to keep my work/personal tasks under separate headings for quick reference. 

It’s the only reason I find myself straying from this app :(

title.label: Apple Watch 9.6 breaks Due iPhone connection

content.label:
After updating to Apple Watch 9.6, when you go to “Mark Done” on the Apple Watch, you get the message “iPhone is Unavailable, Due can’t find your iPhone to act on your reminders”, while other Watch apps find the iPhone.  iPhone 13 Pro, iOS 16.5.1 (c), Watch A2477.
   (Reviews appear to be the only way tp report problems.)
I am so impressed with this app.  It has really helped me since I juggle a lot of different obligations.  It is so easy to change things around and the multiple reminders really help me so much!
Perhaps the most awesome app for reminders. Easy, effective and never fails to surprise with off and on new features. Kudos to the developers!!

title.label: The Best at What it Does

content.label: I use Things for most of my task management, Apple Reminders for shopping lists, and Due is still indispensable for anything I ABSOLUTELY CANNOT AFFORD TO FORGET. Auto snooze is a game changer. Remind me to pack diapers for daycare every 15 minutes when I get home tonight. Absolutely foolproof.

title.label: Nice app but need two added features

content.label:
I really like the app and use it all the time.  There are two features I would like added.   A couple of times I have hit the “complete” check mark button or swiped sideways by accident.   Then the whole reminder is gone and you can’t bring it back.   It would be nice if completed items stayed somewhere for a day or two so that you could bring them back if you made a mistake.    Maybe I’m missing something in the software, but I looked and couldn’t find anything about this. 

The second thing I would like is a way to set quarterly reminders (every three months).  At the moment I just set them monthly and click done on the months they don’t apply, but that is a little confusing.  A typical quarterly thing is a tax payment of some sort, like my local real estate taxes.
I just love it that you can get a custom sound alert PER alert
This is one of the best reminder app. I use it every day. It would be nice to have a calendar view.
R
I’m having sayhmjgg
Worth it
Love this app. I live by it. It’s improved my life, no kidding. One suggestion: add hashtags?

Came here to say that as a busy corporate professional w adult ADHD, the Critical Alerts feature has been life-changing. Whereas most notifications may, at best, vibrate (when phone is on silent), CA's play a 0.5 sec ring. This enables you to separate those absolutely important do-or-die reminders from other nudges.

title.label: Just snoozes everything and get no reminders.

content.label: Set it up so I wouldn’t miss important tasks and received no alerts or notifications. Went back and all tasks said zzz. What good is that?  I can forget things on my own. I double checked the settings and everything was set up properly. Massive fail!

I am a neurodivergent person who really struggles with time management and executive functioning. This app has helped me significantly. Very thankful that no matter the task, it will remind me, and it will blast me repeatedly if I don't respond.

title.label: Does exactly what it says on the tin, and more.

content.label:
I love this app, and I don’t usually say that or give anything five stars. 
This app does exactly what I need it to do. Remind me of something, sometimes on a schedule, and bug me about it until I actually do it. It’s simple, easy to use and works well.

When I say that I have tried them all I pretty much have. This app is perfect. It has every single thing I want. For me nothing is missing. Just try it out. You won’t regret it but give it a few days so you can get used to it. Great work guys! Thank you!

title.label: Very useful- for more than a year!

content.label:
Most useful app. Didn’t like some changes about a year ago but adapted to them. Use it every single day. Best money I’ve ever spent on an app.

I have been using this app for probably two or three years now. I use it every day. Is by far the most useful app I have ever purchased.

This is worth every penny. I use it as a calendar and a daily task list. I have so many alerts set up that I won’t forget anything as long as it is on this app. It’s really helped me get a consistent schedule

Some of the alerts I have are :
Daily allergies meds
Birthdays
Doctors appointments
Next oil change due date
Britta filter change
Swap tooth brush’s every 3 months
Daily note at the end of shift to prep for tomorrow 
Monthly car maintenance checklist

This app is awesome. It's an integral part of my daily life keeping me on track and easy to use all at the same time. I've had it for years and look forward to many more years with Due keeping me on time and on track.
Best-in-class by a mile. Incredible. Can't live without it. Incredible support, and frequent new features. Very stable. Totally cross-platform and syncs really fast! I love it!
This thing is awesome. Not sure why there hasn’t been a good app like this yet!

title.label: This app saved me from depression

content.label: When someone close to me died four years ago, I felt like I couldn’t keep my thoughts straight. I didn’t want to do anything, even things I liked, and I didn’t have the energy to do much more than exist. A friend then recommended this app in an unrelated conversation. My difficulties with attention and organization improved very quickly, and now I can’t think about living without this app! I owe you guys my life. Even though I’m still periodically depressed, I have an easy way to stay on track when my mind just can’t figure it out the old fashioned way. 🙂

I love how customizable you can be with each reminder. Incredible for items you need to have multiple alerts to make sure you get something done. One of the best apps I have ever downloaded to get things done ✅ ✅✅
An absolutely fantastic application, I have been enjoying it for years, and have found it to be a necessary tool for staying productive.

Have been using Due for a number of years. So much better than a ToDo list or calendar reminder. Due never lets me forget a thing and I accomplish so much. I got into the habit of entering events in Due the second I know about them. By doing this, I never miss an appointment, payment, birthday or any event. Due does not let things just pass by undone. At the end of day I am not stressed thinking about what I forgot to do. I use Due more than any other app I have. If you want to get things done, be more responsible and remember the important things in your life, you need Due.

Was looking for an easy to use app that supports local notifications for things I need to "due". Not a traditional ToDo app (ie Things). Due completely addresses my requirements and is so dang easy to use and the UI/UX is awesome! If I could give it more starts I would!

title.label: 5 STARS! Lifesaver for those easily distracted!

content.label: This app has changed everything for me. I would forget from upstairs to downstairs and since this app all I have to do is either look at my phone or hear Siri tell me “add new kitty litter” or whatever! I no longer have the frustration of “what was I doing down here?!” because I set the reminders and the auto snooze is AMAZING! If I just need 5 minutes or a full hour I still need to remember and then like magic (with a very pleasant sound) it pops up on my screen or I can go to the app. It’s simple, straightforward and very useful!  This app is worth its weight in gold for those of us that NEED the reminders while not being too annoying or what I call becoming numb to my tasks.
Overall good but can you add a “week” reminder option? Thanks

The best reminder app ever.
Versatile, and flexible.
What would make it even better is if there was an ability to store images, photos or scans.
Life would be chaos without it!!
A great, great app. Often updated. I have been using it now for eight years, business and personal, and continually recommend it to my employees, friends and family.
